expectation: Membrane ring on scattered myeloid cells: macrophages, monocytes and neutrophils in the lamina propria and submucosa of this gut-like tissue, often near vessels or in inflamed areas. Moderately common, single cells around 10 µm across, with no staining of the epithelium.
notes: CD11b shows a haze over the tissue plus bright dots that look the same on and off the tissue. B and C have only a few blobs, D shows diffuse clouds rather than membrane rings, and CD66b has no structure, so row E cannot help.
observed: A: yellow haze follows the tissue outline, with bright speckle on and off the tissue and faint streaks along the folds. B/C: a few compact bright blobs in the stroma, no membrane rings. D: diffuse irregular yellow clouds, no cell outlines. E: CD66b is a structureless haze, and CD11b shows only isolated blobs.
why: There is no distinct membrane-stained myeloid population: the signal is a haze over the tissue plus blobs that look like the debris lying off the tissue.
